event.description: Reduce learned positional factorization from retained rank 3 to rank 2 while retaining reversed padded operands, d=14, two heads, two blocks, ff=19, and the 45000-step learning-rate-floor schedule.
event.proposal: Family: position representation. Retained incumbent is 3129 parameters at 99.190000%, a +0.190000 percentage-point margin over 99%. Same-family history: the current reversed-input rank-3 setting was accepted as attempt-0034 (3129, 99.19%); the most recent failed result is attempt-0030, rank 2 under forward-order inputs with ff=20, an optimization failure peaking at 11.1% validation; 10 prior position-representation macro-attempts plus the rank-7 schedule reattempt and the combined reversed-input candidate. The immediately preceding ff=18 attempt-0035 is an optimization failure (45000 steps, 10.75% peak validation, no checkpoint), not a scored nonqualification. Hypothesis: operand reversal changes the positional roles sufficiently that rank 2 could now be adequate despite the forward-order failure; retaining the qualifying ff=19 architecture would reduce actual parameters from 3129 to 3080. This is a representational positional factorization, not parameterization-preserving scalar pruning. It is more informative than the nearest untested rank-1 alternative because rank 2 is the direct lower-dimensional boundary from the retained rank-3 reversed-input model.
